reason: In our business a buyer signs because he knows me, met me at the fair, or a partner vouched for us. A cold email from a domain I never heard of does not get a German or Romanian purchasing manager to switch suppliers, so I would take the free list maybe, but I am not putting my name on a pilot.
objection: My team has no time for this, and I do not believe '3 hours in total' once meetings start coming and my sales people have to chase quotes. And one logistics client with 45 meetings tells me nothing about manufacturers in my niche.
would_change_my_mind: If the free list of 15 companies included two or three I already know are the right buyers, and they could show me a reference from a manufacturer or exporter like us that I can call myself.
